title: backend-skeleton impact dispositions
description: Validates specs/<feature_id>/impact-resolution.json, written by `bskel impact disposition`/`bskel impact ack`. Three modes with three genuinely different mechanical consequences (see D-cross-feature-impact-graph's D6): 'compatible' unblocks one {change_key, downstream_feature} pair and nothing else; 'migrate' requires --tracked-by and creates a two-sided handshake (an inbound obligation on the downstream feature, cleared only by that feature's own `impact ack`); 'waive' requires --expires and decays via the same mechanism D-waiver-expiry already ships for `contract waive`. Keyed by {change_key, downstream_feature} -- never a wildcard, matching cross-feature-resolution.schema.json's own stated discipline.

expires_at.description: Required iff mode is 'waive' -- ISO instant this disposition stops covering its change_key.

acknowledged.description: Only meaningful for mode 'migrate' -- flipped true by the DOWNSTREAM feature's own `bskel impact ack`.
